blocks.orig: With a honeymoon in Tanzania and Zanzibar, you say “I do” to romance and the adventure of your lifetime. Everything is possible: our private honeymoon safaris are tailored to your wishes. Though you may have a lot of questions… here you’ll find the answer to the most frequently asked questions from our travellers about their honeymoon.
blocks.html: A honeymoon in Tanzania and Zanzibar means saying “I do” to romance and to the adventure of a lifetime. Anything is possible, because our private honeymoon safaris are built around what you want. Still, you probably have plenty of questions… on this page you’ll find the answers to the questions our travellers ask most often about their honeymoon.

blocks.orig: We always make sure that your accommodations know you are on a honeymoon, and many times this means you get special treatment. Think of the following (sometimes complimentary) services: a fruit basket upon arrival, a room decorated in honeymoon style, a bottle of wine or champagne upon arrival, or a special cake. But don’t be afraid to tell everyone and anyone, as everyone loves honeymooners and are happy to go the extra mile to make your stay even more perfect.
blocks.html: We always let your accommodations know that you are honeymooners, and in many cases that earns you some special treatment. You might receive (sometimes complimentary) extras such as a fruit basket when you arrive, a room decorated in honeymoon style, a bottle of wine or champagne on arrival, or a special cake. And do feel free to tell anyone and everyone: people love honeymooners and are glad to go the extra mile to make your stay even more perfect.

blocks.orig: Of course. We love surprises and would do anything to make it happen! Whether you want to surprise your love with a cake or champagne in a certain lodge, or plan an incredible ride in a hot-air balloon, please inform your travel consultant. They will provide you with more information and prices or (complimentary) possibilities in the parks and lodges on your itinerary.
blocks.html: Absolutely. We are fond of surprises and will do whatever we can to arrange one! Whether you would like to surprise your partner with a cake or champagne at a particular lodge, or set up a spectacular hot-air balloon ride, just let your travel consultant know. They can give you further details and prices, as well as the (complimentary) options available in the parks and lodges on your itinerary.

blocks.orig: If you want to make your trip even more romantic, there are some special activities we can arrange for you. Think of a cosy bush dinner for two, a romantic hot-air balloon ride above the savannah or a sunset cruise on the Indian Ocean. Or… renew your vows during a Maasai wedding ceremony… truly a once-in-a-lifetime experience! You’ll find our top activities for honeymooners on this page.
blocks.html: Should you wish to add extra romance to your trip, there are several special activities we can organise. Picture an intimate bush dinner for two, a romantic hot-air balloon flight over the savannah or a sunset cruise on the Indian Ocean. Or… renew your vows in a Maasai wedding ceremony… a genuine once-in-a-lifetime moment! Our top activities for honeymooners are listed on this page.

blocks.orig: It all depends on your wishes and budget. You can choose from comfortable and budget-friendly lodges (our Silver category), more luxurious hotels with cosy rooms, swimming pools and delicious food (our Gold category) and the most high-end accommodations pampering you with private villas, exquisite dining and romance galore (our Platinum category). If you want to stay at the crème de la crème, our Diamond Luxury resorts are perfect for you. These hotels are the country’s highest standard and make you feel like you are in Seventh Heaven.
blocks.html: That depends entirely on your wishes and your budget. The choice ranges from comfortable, budget-friendly lodges (our Silver category), through more luxurious hotels with cosy rooms, swimming pools and excellent food (our Gold category), to the most high-end accommodations that spoil you with private villas, exquisite dining and romance in abundance (our Platinum category). And if only the crème de la crème will do, our Diamond Luxury resorts are made for you. These hotels represent the highest standard in the country and will leave you feeling as if you are in Seventh Heaven.

blocks.orig: A day to remember: Wedding Ceremony with the Maasai
blocks.html: A day to cherish: a wedding ceremony with the Maasai

blocks.orig: Extend your wedding you had at home or renew your vows in a traditional Maasai wedding ceremony in the middle of the savannah! The women of the tribe dress and adorn the bride with traditional clothing and jewellery and take her into a wedding boma. The warriors take the groom to meet the bride, after which an elder blesses you. The entire tribe welcomes you as a married couple – including singing, dancing and eating goat meat, the last step of a Maasai wedding. Ready to get married (again)?
blocks.html: Carry on the wedding you celebrated at home, or renew your vows, with a traditional Maasai wedding ceremony right in the heart of the savannah! The women of the tribe dress the bride in traditional clothing and jewellery and lead her into a wedding boma. The warriors then bring the groom to meet his bride, and an elder gives you his blessing. The whole tribe welcomes you as a married couple, with singing, dancing and a meal of goat meat as the final step of a Maasai wedding. Ready to tie the knot (again)?
